programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show.

programme.title: Battle Tour - EastvsWest
programme.desc: It is more than just a food and travel show as it is a cultural journey. The program blends travel, cuisine, and culture, inviting viewers not only to taste but also to experience the stories, people, and places behind Taiwanese food and destinations.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: Family Reunion
programme.desc: A lively grandmother, a warm-hearted couple and their four daughters run a tangyuan shop. Working together to prepare glutinous rice balls for every joyful occasion, the family transforms its modest business into a neighbourhood symbol of warmth, togetherness and reunion.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 1
programme.desc: Wu Dang Sect's Zhang Chui Shan's son, Zhang Wu Ji, finds himself accidentally embroiled in the fight for the Dragon Sabre. When he unwittingly learns the powerful martial arts skills from the Jiuyin scriptures, Wu Ji proceeds to help the Six Major sects fight against the corrupt government.

programme.title: Old Fox
programme.desc: In 1989, young Liao Jie and his father save for a home, unaware of rising property prices. Frustrated by poverty, he learns from their landlord Old Fox who teaches him survival in society. Liao Jie ends up hurting Old Fox with what he has learnt, but his empathy prevents him from becoming like Old Fox.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: This dark comedy begins with an unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into "haunted flats", which will cause a drastic drop in the property value, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away, embroiling themselves in chaos.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: After being betrayed by Zhuo, the white-haired witch Lian seeks revenge by slaughtering her way through the eight martial arts clans. However, she is soon attacked by a man whose bride she has abducted. Meanwhile, Zhuo, who is waiting on a hilltop for a flower to bloom for Lian's restoration, hastens to save her upon realizing the danger she is in.

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend
programme.desc: This is a love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy and is the first Bollywood movie to be made in Hong Kong. It encapsulates the conflicts caused by discrimination as well as differences in social-cultural background, lifestyle and family values between the races. The movie also combines tears, joy and laughter with song and dance.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella
programme.desc: Following the chaos unleashed by Pandora's Box, Joker is thrust through time and begins to awaken as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Torn between mortal emotions and divine destiny, he struggles to reconcile his love for Zixia Fairy with the responsibilities of his past.

programme.title: Leio
programme.desc: An ex-singer Kao returns to his hometown for a funeral and takes part in a water drilling contest to save his drought-stricken hometown, as well as to win a million dollar cash prize. However, what Kao and other contestants do not realize is that there is a fierce and deadly beast lurking underground who wants to eat them all!

programme.title: Scare Out
programme.desc: A leak of core technology from an advanced fighter jet programme sparks a national security crisis. As an intelligence unit's urban manhunt for the spy falters, suspicion turns inward, falling on one of their own. Trust unravels as two top agents, once allies, are drawn into a silent, ruthless duel where one misstep could prove fatal.

programme.title: Lelio PoPo
programme.desc: Former radio DJs KK and Ah Luke were once hugely popular, but their bad attitudes and eccentric behaviour got them fired. Desperate for a comeback, they audition for a new radio station searching for elderly female hosts. Disguising themselves as old ladies, the pair unexpectedly land the job and spark a series of hilarious misadventures.

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Famous pop idol Peng travels to Rome for a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Mang, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy. Peng and Mang have nothing in common but spend a magical night in Rome together. Their lives begin to change as the two start to fall in love.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: When some gangsters led by a ruthless American property developer force a school to sell their land, Ip Man fights to protect it. Subsequently, Ip Man is challenged by another Wing Chun master Zhang Tian Zhi for the Grandmaster title. Ip Man accepts the challenge for the sake of his family and disciples, and wins the duel for the title.

programme.title: The Ex-files 4: Marriage Plan
programme.desc: Two brothers, Meng Yun and Yu Fei, are of marriageable age and are facing challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, while Fei and his girlfriend opt for a “marriage cooling-off period” to tackle marriage issues.

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her family's massacre years ago.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from “Fake Ghost Catchers” Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: The Blue And The Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty's Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan…

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daughter in hatred, training her into the fearsome "Silver Fox" and sending her out for revenge.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Taufik keliru dengan perasaannya kerana sering terbayangkan Ana lalu mengadu kepada Dato' Ishmael tanpa pengetahuan Johan. Johan pula mengadu kepada Nani yang dia syak Ana sukakan Taufik. Ana cuba yakinkan Johan yang dia betul suka terhadapnya, bukan Taufik walaupun dia sendiri mula meragui perasaannya. Edora juga semakin rasa tercabar dengan Ana dan sering resah gelisah.

programme.title: Oppss Terpikat Cik Sombong
programme.desc: Hans menukar penampilan setelah dipaksa oleh Imran. Marlia dan Ira begitu terperanjat melihat penampilan Hans yang begitu kacak sekali. Ira dah mula rasa cemburu apabila Hans memuji Farah, salah seorang pekerja di syarikat mereka. Ira yang telah boleh berjalan terus sahaja meminta supaya dia mula kembali bekerja. Ketika membelibelah baju baru untuk ke pejabat bersama Hans, tiba-tiba Reez muncul di depan Ira. Reez minta diberi peluang kedua tetapi Ira telah lama membenci Reez. Ira terus pergi meninggalkan Reez. Ira mula merasaan dia selamat dan gembira bila bersama Hans. Walaupun bicara Ira terhadap Hans tetap kasar tetapi nadanya sudah berbeza dari dulu. Marlia perasan akan perubahan pada Ira. Marlia minta Ira tunaikan janjinya untuk berpisah dengan Hans. Ira mengadu kepada Imran dan memberitahu yang dia tidak sanggup berpisah dengan lelaki yang baik seperti Hans.

Anggara dan Aini merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang hidup bahagia. Namun, menjelang ulang tahun perkahwinan mereka, Aini disahkan menghidap penyakit otak yang menyebabkan dia kehilangan ingatan secara berperingkat sehingga tidak lagi mengenali suaminya sendiri. Dalam tempoh yang semakin singkat, Anggara berusaha mempertahankan cinta mereka sambil menemani Aini menghadapi detik-detik paling sukar dalam hidupnya. Selepas pemergian Aini, sebuah rakaman video yang ditinggalkannya mendedahkan rahsia yang mengubah kehidupan Anggara buat selama-lamanya.

Taufik dapat menghidu yang Ana menghadapi masalah besar apabila ternampak slip bank dengan jumlah yang besar. Taufik berjaya selamatkan Ana dari terus menjadi mangsa Shahir dan Ana terpaksa berterus terang dengan Taufik bahawa Shahir adalah bekas tunangnya.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP9

Tanjung, Sabtu, Kuala Trengganu yang dikatakan mempunyai misteri tersendiri. Beliau bertemu dengan Encik Salleh Abdullah, beberapa istana lama yang dibina oleh Almarhum Tengku Ismail kerabat di raja Trengganu yang dijadikan pusat tenun kain songket orang kampung. Kononnya satu keluarga bunian masih berada di lokasi. Ossasuke Hikaru (OH) seorang aktivitis Paranormal berkongsi pengalaman yang pernah dilalui semasa menjalankan aktiviti di situ. Pengantara bersama OH dan krew kemudiannya berada di lokasi istana lama tersebut selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi seram dan menakutkan.

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk "Jangan Bernafas". Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai "footage" menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

programme.title: Suratan Kasih
programme.desc: Sunny mengalami tekanan jiwa selepas melihat ibunya yang sedang berzina mati dibunuh ayahnya sendiri. Apabila meningkat dewasa, Sunny menjadi seorang pembunuh bersiri di sebalik kerjayanya sebagai komposer dan pemuzik. Mangsanya ialah golongan artis yang melakukan perbuatan zina. Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Rahsia
programme.desc: Dihantui gangguan misteri, sepasang suami isteri mula mencari punca kepada gangguan tersebut. Profesor Hamdan dan Ramlah serta anak mereka, Saiful dan Marina berpindah ke sebuah banglo lama di tepi laut. Mereka hidup aman dan damai bersama di banglo tersebut. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Imigran
programme.desc: Faridah, pekerja warga asing terlibat dalam kes jenayah apabila telah menjadi saksi kes pembunuhan. Bertemu Hisham ketika cuba melarikan diri, mereka berdua mula jatuh cinta selepas menghabiskan masa bersama di kampung Hisham. Konflik berlaku apabila penjenayah tersilap menculik orang yang menyebabkan Faridah dan Hisham perlu melakukan sesuatu untuk menyelamatkan Azura.

programme.title: Mama Oh Mama
programme.desc: Ani, seorang perempuan yang berperwatakan liar sering melakukan perkara yang tidak dipersetujui oleh ibu bapanya . Dia sering mengunjungi kelab malam dan keluar bersama teman lelakinya . Walaupun dinasihati oleh orang gajinya, Ani tetap tidak berubah sikap.

programme.title: Gemerlapan
programme.desc: Mimi mengejutkan ramai pelajar di sebuah kolej berprestij kerana menjadi seorang penggemar muzik dangdut yang tegar. Nel, salah seorang pelajar di situ menganggap muzik dangdut kekampungan dan mereka berdua sering bertengkar kerana hal tersebut. Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.title: Hayya 2: Dream Hope And Reality
programme.desc: Filem sekuel ini menyorot trauma dan kehilangan. Hayya melarikan diri ke Indonesia lalu bertemu Lia dan Faisal, yang akhirnya menganggapnya sebagai pengikat rumah tangga mereka. Sementara Rahmat, Adhin dan Ricis terus mencarinya, rahsia keluarga Faisal terbongkar hingga tragedi besar berlaku.

programme.title: Rumput Tetangga
programme.desc: Kirana, seorang suri rumah yang pernah menjadi pelajar cemerlang, berasa tidak puas hati dengan kehidupannya. Selepas mendapat peluang misteri untuk menjadi wanita kerjaya yang berjaya, dia mula menyedari bahawa kehidupan yang diimpikan tidak semestinya membawa kebahagiaan tanpa keluarga tersayang.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: Love Supermoon
programme.desc: Mengisahkan seorang lelaki dan seorang wanita yang menjalani kehidupan masing-masing tetapi sering bertemu di majlis perkahwinan atau parti yang dianjurkan oleh rakan-rakan mereka. Mereka hanya mengenali antara satu sama lain melalui gosip yang didengar, namun berpura-pura tidak mengenali setiap kali bertemu.

programme.title: Duyung
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jimmy, seorang pemuda kampung yang mencintai alam sekitar dan hidup sederhana di tepi laut. Suatu hari, dia menyelamatkan seekor ikan duyung yang bertukar menjadi gadis jelita bernama Puteri. Pertemuan itu mengubah hidup Jimmy dan mencetuskan pelbagai kejadian lucu serta romantik antara manusia dan duyung.

programme.title: Perindu Senja
programme.desc: Che Embun, seorang wanita tua, setiap hari menanti kepulangan suaminya, Bakar, yang hilang di laut. Menjelang Aidilfitri, dia berharap suaminya akan kembali apabila menghidu rendang itik kegemarannya. Sambil menunggu, Che Embun juga menjaga dan melindungi seorang gadis istimewa bernama Nomi daripada perlakuan buruk ibunya. Cerita ini tentang cinta, pengharapan dan kesetiaan walau diuji masa dan penantian.

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Syahadah Terakhir
programme.desc: Telefilem ini mengisahkan tentang Pak Yusuf yang amat menyayangi anak-anaknya, Razlan dan Rafidah, tetapi selepas kematian isterinya, dia mula menumpang di rumah anak-anaknya dan sikapnya yang cerewet serta kerap membanding-bandingkan harta menyebabkan konflik keluarga. Rafidah menjadi tersepit antara suaminya Zaidi dan tekanan dari bapanya.

programme.title: Mat Tudung
programme.desc: Johari, seorang bekas playboy dan Mat Rempit, jatuh hati pada gadis sopan bernama Zizie yang hanya menyukai lelaki berakhlak baik. Untuk menambat hati Zizie, Johari menyamar sebagai “adiknya” Johanna, lalu tercetus pelbagai situasi lucu dan kecoh.

programme.title: Pelangi Tanpa Warna
programme.desc: Fedi dan Kirana adalah pasangan bahagia yang hidup dengan rancangan masa depan yang indah. Namun semuanya berubah apabila Kirana didiagnosis mengidap Alzheimer, sehingga ingatannya perlahan memudar dari hal-hal sederhana hingga yang paling penting dalam hidupnya. Fedi kini diuji untuk terus setia dan menjaga keluarganya dalam keadaan yang semakin mencabar.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Buli Balik
programme.desc: Sekuel kepada Buli, Nordin kini berjaya dalam kerjaya dan kehidupan tetapi apabila Roy, bekas pembulinya, hilang ingatan selepas kemalangan, situasi bertukar lucu dan dramatik apabila kuasa kini berada di tangan Nordin.

programme.title: Buli
programme.desc: Mengisahkan seorang lelaki yang sering dibuli rakan sekerja, lalu memutuskan untuk membalas dendam dengan cara lucu dan dramatik, sambil menghadapi konflik peribadi dan hubungan cinta.

programme.title: Mukhsin
programme.desc: Filem ini menceritakan kisah cinta pertama seorang budak lelaki bernama Mukhsin dengan seorang gadis bernama Orked. Berlatar di kampung, mereka mengalami pengalaman manis dan penuh emosi dalam kehidupan seharian, persahabatan, serta hubungan keluarga. Filem ini mengangkat tema kepolosan, kasih sayang dan nostalgia zaman kanak-kanak.

programme.title: Hayya 1: The Power Of Love
programme.desc: Rahmat, wartawan yang dihantui dosa silam, berhijrah jadi relawan di kem pelarian Palestin dan bertemu Hayya, anak yatim piatu. Pertemuan itu mengubah hidupnya, namun bila dia pulang ke Indonesia untuk berkahwin dengan Yasna, tercetus konflik emosi yang rumit, lucu dan tegang antara mereka.

programme.title: Nenek Gayung
programme.desc: Nenek Gayung is an Indonesian horror-comedy about a supernatural figure known as Nenek Gayung who is linked to a series of mysterious deaths and eerie incidents. A group of young people becomes entangled in the mystery and experiences a mix of scary and comedic situations while trying to uncover the truth.

programme.title: War Of Thorns & What's On Today
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Game of Deceit
programme.desc: The tricky CHING (CHEUNG KA FAI) and the loafer, JIAN, (CHIN KA LOK) always cheat to earn a living. Unexpectedly, they incur, JIAN`s teacher, SUN (LIU KAI CHI) to death. They even make the banker, HUNG (LAW LOK LAU)`s business bankrupted and HUNG`s daughter, PO, (CHEUNG YUK SHAN) has become a courtesan. CHING has disclosed LUN (HSUAN JESSICA HESTER)`s female identity who is the owner of a famous adjusting agent `The First Tooth`. LUN forces CHING to marry her so as to protect her adjusting agent`s reputation. To CHING it is a great torture as he has to change from a tricky swindler to an impartial adjuster. CHING has then become the person in-charge of the adjusting agent. With CHING`s talent together with JIAN and LUN`s assistance, they manage to clear up many swindling cases such as `The Virgin Courtesan`, `The Twins` and `The Nice Weather` etc. Though CHING and LUN, JIAN and PO are enemies at the beginning, they gradually become lovers.

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals…

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: The Ex-files 4: Marriage Plan
programme.desc: Two brothers, Meng Yun and Yu Fei, are of marriageable age and are facing challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, while Fei and his girlfriend opt for a “marriage cooling-off period” to tackle marriage issues.

programme.title: Tales from the Occult: Ultimate Malevolence
programme.desc: The final chapter of 'Tales From The Occult', the movie features three short stories about two high school friends, a magician undergoing hypnosis to find her missing friend, and a man finding his way out of a mysterious building. The stories reveal the most terrifying and ugly side of human nature, where life and death are just a thought away!

programme.title: Born to Fly
programme.desc: Lei Yu has officially become the new generation of Chinese test pilots after rounds of strict selection. Captain Zhang Ting leads Lei Yu and other pilots to test the latest fighter jets. Lei Yu keeps pushing the limits in each test flight in the hope of coming up with the perfect plane to ensure the safety of the fighter pilots.

programme.title: Love is Blind, Hate Too
programme.desc: Bo lost her eye sight in a serious car accident a year ago. One day, she is left alone at home when her husband is away on a work trip. An intruder enters Bo's house and takes her hostage. As Bo tries to survive his mental and psychological torture, she discovers her husband's secret which is related to the accident leading to her blindness…

programme.title: Shining For One Thing
programme.desc: Zhang Wan Sen plans to confess his crush on Lin Bei Xing after the college entrance exam, but an accident changes everything tragically. As Zhang feels helpless and devastated, he fortuitously travels back in time with Lin before the accident happens. Can he make amends and convey his regrets this time?

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: Due to the negligence of sharp-tongued barrister Adrian, his innocent client is convicted of murder and sentenced to 17 years in jail. An opportunity to appeal the case and free his client arises a few years later, but in order to right his wrong, he must fight against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong for justice to prevail.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive Zhi Shi Lang across the desert to Chang'an, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: One and Only
programme.desc: Veteran street dancer Ding Lei, invites passionate street dancer, Chen Shuo to his dance club. Sparks fly when Chen dances with the club's top dancers. Chen pursues his dream to perform but discovers that Ding has invited him for another reason. As both of them deal with hard times, can they turn the tide on the challenges that they are facing?

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Last Suspect
programme.desc: Lawyer Chen receives a mysterious call demanding her to defend a murder suspect after her daughter is kidnapped, and is told that she can only save her daughter by winning the case. As she starts investigation with the police and evidence emerges, Chen discovers the truth and reveals the mastermind. Can she rescue her daughter in time?

programme.title: Mama's Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung stays home to take care of her husband and son after retirement. She decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol. This makes her teenage son, Jonathan, intensely jealous of Fong Ching.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fan's fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancée, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancée to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire.

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - “Twelve Deadly Coins” and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: When The Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out…

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her…

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys?

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father…

programme.desc: Aira sanggup terbang ke Wales demi membawa pulang tunangnya, Darwish. Namun setibanya di sana, dia mendapati Darwish sebenarnya memutuskan pertunangan kerana orang ketiga, Marissa. Dalam kecewa, Aira bertemu Jaka, jejaka Kelantan yang bekerja sebagai pencuci pinggan di sebuah kafe. Jaka kemudian bersetuju membantu Aira menawan kembali hati Darwish… tetapi perjalanan itu membuka cerita yang tidak disangka.

programme.title: Deko Bajet
programme.desc: Untuk episod ini, pereka bentuk dalaman, Janna Baha selaku pengacara juga akan menghias semula bilik belajar anak milik pasangan Putri dan Tengku di sebuahkondominium di Setapak dengan hanya Rm 3,000.00.

programme.title: Aroma Masak
programme.desc: Hani Fadzil selaku hos musim ini akan menyediakan 2 menu istimewa iaitu Makaroni Bebola Daging & Ro3 Karbonara sambil ditemani oleh artis jemputan, Addnan Sarippuddin.

programme.title: Podcast Lagenda
programme.desc: Saksikan Podcast Lagenda bersama figura seni tanah air, Dato' A.Rahim (Imuda). Beliau berkongsi perjalanan unik dalam industri, ujian yang ditempuhi, pengalaman sebalik tabir, sisi peribadi, serta nasihat bermakna buat generasi muda yang ingin menceburi bidang seni. Jangan lepaskan peluang ini!

programme.title: Secret Book Club
programme.desc: Keberanian Shasha membela Hidayah mendapat tentangan hebat daripada Pengetua dan Tuan Mustafa. Sementara Tini terus menjadi mangsa dera bapa saudaranya, Shasha nekad menubuhkan kelab buku biarpun disabotaj. Tini, Maya, dan Hidayah akhirnya menyertai kelab tersebut, tanpa menyedari mereka sedang diperhatikan oleh Ustazah Harissa.

programme.title: Misteri Mona
programme.desc: Farah yang awalnya skeptikal tentang Mona, terdiam apabila Anom secara tiba-tiba 'memperkenalkan' Mona kepadanya. Pada masa yang sama, hasil pemeriksaan ubat Anom oleh Ikmal menimbulkan syak wasangka baharu.

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Usop cuba dapatkan wok dengan mencari deris. Namun siapa diri deris sudah mulai terbongkar. Dia tidak endah permintaan usop mengenai pemergiaan maimun. Betapa kejamnya deris, tidak langsung membawa wok balik untuk melihat arwah maimun untuk kali terakhir. Wok disiksa teruk dan tekad cuba membunuh deris.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP10
programme.desc: Pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful Azmi Jamsari serta dibantu oleh krewkrew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan berada di Jerantut, Pahang. Kisah misteri dan mistik yang ingin diterokai adalah Gua Kota Gelanggi terletak di Taman Warisan berusia 130 tahun. Beliau menemu bual Encik Muhamad Mohd Yunus, Penyelidik Muzium dan Jurulatih Kebudayaan Pahang dan Encik Osman Ahmad seorang peneroka. Gua ini dijadikan temapt pertapaan dan menuntut ilmu batin menyebabkan berlakunya kejadian misteri saperti penampilan lembaga berjubah dan berpakaian orang asli. Pengantara bersama krew dan Encik kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di gua tersebut selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi yang menakutkan dan sama saperti diceritakan

programme.title: Gemerlapan
programme.desc: Mimi mengejutkan ramai pelajar di sebuah kolej berprestij kerana menjadi seorang penggemar muzik dangdut yang tegar. Nel, salah seorang pelajar di situ menganggap muzik dangdut kekampungan dan mereka berdua sering bertengkar kerana hal tersebut. Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.title: Jogho
programme.desc: Dendam menguasai masyarakat Melayu Patani di Thailand Selatan. Kalah dalam pertempuran lembu jantan, lawannya dibunuh yang juga saudara kepada Mamat - yang berjanji untuk membalas dendam bagi kematian saudaranya. Sifat dendam dalam masyarakat Melayu tetap mengalir kerana isteri Mamat, Minah gagal untuk menghentikan kitaran kejam itu.

programme.title: Suratan Kasih
programme.desc: Sunny mengalami tekanan jiwa selepas melihat ibunya yang sedang berzina mati dibunuh ayahnya sendiri. Apabila meningkat dewasa, Sunny menjadi seorang pembunuh bersiri di sebalik kerjayanya sebagai komposer dan pemuzik. Mangsanya ialah golongan artis yang melakukan perbuatan zina. Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

programme.title: Rahsia
programme.desc: Dihantui gangguan misteri, sepasang suami isteri mula mencari punca kepada gangguan tersebut. Profesor Hamdan dan Ramlah serta anak mereka, Saiful dan Marina berpindah ke sebuah banglo lama di tepi laut. Mereka hidup aman dan damai bersama di banglo tersebut. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

programme.title: Mama Oh Mama
programme.desc: Ani, seorang perempuan yang berperwatakan liar sering melakukan perkara yang tidak dipersetujui oleh ibu bapanya . Dia sering mengunjungi kelab malam dan keluar bersama teman lelakinya . Walaupun dinasihati oleh orang gajinya, Ani tetap tidak berubah sikap.

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk "Jangan Bernafas". Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai "footage" menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Imigran
programme.desc: Faridah, pekerja warga asing terlibat dalam kes jenayah apabila telah menjadi saksi kes pembunuhan. Bertemu Hisham ketika cuba melarikan diri, mereka berdua mula jatuh cinta selepas menghabiskan masa bersama di kampung Hisham. Konflik berlaku apabila penjenayah tersilap menculik orang yang menyebabkan Faridah dan Hisham perlu melakukan sesuatu untuk menyelamatkan Azura.

programme.title: Hayya 1: The Power Of Love
programme.desc: Rahmat, wartawan yang dihantui dosa silam, berhijrah jadi relawan di kem pelarian Palestin dan bertemu Hayya, anak yatim piatu. Pertemuan itu mengubah hidupnya, namun bila dia pulang ke Indonesia untuk berkahwin dengan Yasna, tercetus konflik emosi yang rumit, lucu dan tegang antara mereka.

programme.title: Nenek Gayung
programme.desc: Nenek Gayung is an Indonesian horror-comedy about a supernatural figure known as Nenek Gayung who is linked to a series of mysterious deaths and eerie incidents. A group of young people becomes entangled in the mystery and experiences a mix of scary and comedic situations while trying to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Kembalinya Nenek Gayung
programme.desc: Kembalinya Nenek Gayung tells the story of the return of Nenek Gayung, a mysterious old woman associated with supernatural events and a series of terrifying incidents. A group of young people become involved in strange and frightening encounters while uncovering the mystery behind her reappearance, mixed with comedic moments.

programme.title: Rumput Tetangga
programme.desc: Kirana, seorang suri rumah yang pernah menjadi pelajar cemerlang, berasa tidak puas hati dengan kehidupannya. Selepas mendapat peluang misteri untuk menjadi wanita kerjaya yang berjaya, dia mula menyedari bahawa kehidupan yang diimpikan tidak semestinya membawa kebahagiaan tanpa keluarga tersayang.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: Love Supermoon
programme.desc: Mengisahkan seorang lelaki dan seorang wanita yang menjalani kehidupan masing-masing tetapi sering bertemu di majlis perkahwinan atau parti yang dianjurkan oleh rakan-rakan mereka. Mereka hanya mengenali antara satu sama lain melalui gosip yang didengar, namun berpura-pura tidak mengenali setiap kali bertemu.

programme.title: Duyung
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jimmy, seorang pemuda kampung yang mencintai alam sekitar dan hidup sederhana di tepi laut. Suatu hari, dia menyelamatkan seekor ikan duyung yang bertukar menjadi gadis jelita bernama Puteri. Pertemuan itu mengubah hidup Jimmy dan mencetuskan pelbagai kejadian lucu serta romantik antara manusia dan duyung.

programme.title: Perindu Senja
programme.desc: Che Embun, seorang wanita tua, setiap hari menanti kepulangan suaminya, Bakar, yang hilang di laut. Menjelang Aidilfitri, dia berharap suaminya akan kembali apabila menghidu rendang itik kegemarannya. Sambil menunggu, Che Embun juga menjaga dan melindungi seorang gadis istimewa bernama Nomi daripada perlakuan buruk ibunya. Cerita ini tentang cinta, pengharapan dan kesetiaan walau diuji masa dan penantian.

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Syahadah Terakhir
programme.desc: Telefilem ini mengisahkan tentang Pak Yusuf yang amat menyayangi anak-anaknya, Razlan dan Rafidah, tetapi selepas kematian isterinya, dia mula menumpang di rumah anak-anaknya dan sikapnya yang cerewet serta kerap membanding-bandingkan harta menyebabkan konflik keluarga. Rafidah menjadi tersepit antara suaminya Zaidi dan tekanan dari bapanya.

programme.title: Mat Tudung
programme.desc: Johari, seorang bekas playboy dan Mat Rempit, jatuh hati pada gadis sopan bernama Zizie yang hanya menyukai lelaki berakhlak baik. Untuk menambat hati Zizie, Johari menyamar sebagai “adiknya” Johanna, lalu tercetus pelbagai situasi lucu dan kecoh.

programme.title: Pelangi Tanpa Warna
programme.desc: Fedi dan Kirana adalah pasangan bahagia yang hidup dengan rancangan masa depan yang indah. Namun semuanya berubah apabila Kirana didiagnosis mengidap Alzheimer, sehingga ingatannya perlahan memudar dari hal-hal sederhana hingga yang paling penting dalam hidupnya. Fedi kini diuji untuk terus setia dan menjaga keluarganya dalam keadaan yang semakin mencabar.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Buli Balik
programme.desc: Sekuel kepada Buli, Nordin kini berjaya dalam kerjaya dan kehidupan tetapi apabila Roy, bekas pembulinya, hilang ingatan selepas kemalangan, situasi bertukar lucu dan dramatik apabila kuasa kini berada di tangan Nordin.

programme.title: Buli
programme.desc: Mengisahkan seorang lelaki yang sering dibuli rakan sekerja, lalu memutuskan untuk membalas dendam dengan cara lucu dan dramatik, sambil menghadapi konflik peribadi dan hubungan cinta.

programme.title: Habibie Ainun 3
programme.desc: mengisahkan perjalanan hidup Ainun ketika muda, seorang gadis bijak dan bercita-cita tinggi yang melanjutkan pengajian dalam bidang perubatan. Dalam mengejar impiannya, Ainun berdepan pelbagai cabaran, persahabatan dan kisah cinta yang membentuk dirinya sebelum bertemu dengan Habibie.

programme.title: Band Academy
programme.desc: Band Academy ialah sebuah pertandingan bakat yang bertujuan mencari kumpulan muzik terbaik.

programme.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.

programme.title: Jagain Jodoh Orang Jangan Ya Dek Ya
programme.desc: Feni mempunyai seorang kekasih bernama Madun. Namun, hubungan mereka tidak direstui oleh ibu Feni kerana Madun tidak berpelajaran tinggi dan hanya bekerja sebagai pemandu ojek dengan pendapatan yang sederhana. Hal ini menyebabkan ibu Feni melarang mereka untuk bersama sehingga Madun menjadi kaya. Akhirnya, Feni memutuskan untuk mengakhiri hubungan mereka, tetapi Madun menolak. Feni kemudiannya berhijrah ke bandar untuk mencari pasangan yang berharta.

programme.title: THE WITCH: PART 2. THE OTHER ONE
programme.desc: A mysterious girl survived a blood raid in a secret lab found herself being tracked down by a group of assassins.

programme.title: ONCE AGAIN
programme.desc: Woo-seok in his 40's has always dreamt of going back to his high school days when he had the best days of his life. After an accident, he wakes up and finds himself in the year 1997...

As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: Game of Deceit

CHING has disclosed LUN (HSUAN JESSICA HESTER)`s female identity who is the owner of a famous adjusting agent `The First Tooth`. LUN forces CHING to marry her so as to protect her adjusting agent`s reputation. To CHING it is a great torture as he has to change from a tricky swindler to an impartial adjuster. CHING has then become the person in-charge of the adjusting agent. With CHING`s talent together with JIAN and LUN`s assistance, they manage to clear up many swindling cases such as `The Virgin Courtesan`, `The Twins` and `The Nice Weather` etc. Though CHING and LUN, JIAN and PO are enemies at the beginning, they gradually become lovers.

programme.title: Mama's Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung stays home to take care of her husband and son after retirement. She decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol. This makes her teenage son, Jonathan, intensely jealous of Fong Ching.

programme.title: She’s Got No Name
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks “Jiang Yuan Nong”. Frail woman Zhan Zhou Shi, driven to despair by years of domestic abuse, kills and dismembers her husband, then remains at the scene to surrender. The case seems clear-cut, yet remains riddled with doubt. As the truth unravels, a shocking reversal rewrites everyone's fate.

programme.title: Shock Wave
programme.desc: Bomb specialist Cheung Choi San sets out to capture a wanted criminal called Blast. However, will he be able to do it in time before Blast kills hundreds of citizens inside Hong Kong's busiest Cross Harbour Tunnel and destroys everything in his quest for revenge?

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: Once a gangster, Li struggles to find work to pay for his father's heart surgery. To earn money, he goes undercover to help shut down Life Hotel for a redevelopment project, but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As Li discovers that the hotel serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and empathy.

programme.title: Crypto Storm
programme.desc: ICAC investigation officer Lok sets up a special team to investigate a corruption case involving a bank's top executive's use of cryptocurrency to manipulate the trading market. When the bank's chairman is kidnapped and kidnappers demand ransom in crypto coins, Lok connects the dots and vows to hunt down the mastermind behind both crimes.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: Tales From The Occult: Body And Soul
programme.desc: This horror anthology series returns to feature three spooky crime stories about an ex-hair model, a cat lover and the love triangle between a dental nurse, a dentist and a chef. The stories depict their paths from obsession to madness, eventually tipping them over to the dark side of human nature.

programme.title: Go for Broke
programme.desc: A ruthless drug trafficking group has destroyed countless families due to drug addiction, including Zhang Yao's family. Vowing to take revenge, Zhang Yao teams up with Detective An to take down the drug lords. As their revenge plot unfolds, do they share a common foe or harbour personal agendas?

programme.title: Under Current
programme.desc: A charity gala turns deadly when the finance director is found dead and HK$200 million in donations vanish. Lawyer Ma Ying Fung joins an inspector to uncover a web of money laundering and murder.

programme.title: Everything Under Control
programme.desc: During a diamond heist, one of the security escorts, Jelly, steals the diamonds and flees. Fellow security escorts, Yau Shing and Penguin, are forced to help the robber track down the diamonds. They stumble onto a remote village along the way, encountering strange villagers and mysterious incidents. Can they finally locate Jelly and the diamonds?

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: Guided by mysterious dreams, archaeologist Jack discovers he was General Meng Yi in a past life and shared a tragic love with Princess Ok-Soo that spanned a thousand years. When they reunite in Emperor Qin's celestial palace, a ruthless tycoon seeks the secret of immortality. Reclaiming his past strength, Jack faces a final battle of destiny.

programme.title: The Wig
programme.desc: Meng Zhong is a law graduate overwhelmed by despair after failing the bar exam three times and vents his frustration on a drunken passenger one stormy night. Twenty years later, Meng is a successful lawyer, but his investigation into a sexual assault case involving a young girl rekindles haunting memories he cannot escape.

programme.title: Scare Out
programme.desc: A leak of core technology from an advanced fighter jet programme sparks a national security crisis. As an intelligence unit's urban manhunt for the spy falters, suspicion turns inward, falling on one of their own. Trust unravels as two top agents, once allies, are drawn into a silent, ruthless duel where one misstep could prove fatal.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father…

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back…

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Qing enforcer Luo Yi Hu murders rebel Chen Gui, forcing his wife and daughter Xiao Wei to flee to Guang Long Town. There, mischievous Jia Yu discovers his master's identity as a rebel while helping Xiao Wei. After his loved ones and mentor are killed, Jia Yu sheds his playful ways and seeks vengeance, facing the Qing forces in a final battle.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Ying's father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt “Shaolin Hand Lock” from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling's house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him…

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: Saat Aku Tahu
programme.desc: Perang dingin antara Ameena dan Maria akhirnya meletus menjadi konfrontasi terbuka. Di belakang Zarif, kedua-dua wanita berebut untuk melihat siapa yang benar-benar mengawalnya. Tetapi apabila obsesi Maria semakin mendalam, dia berisiko kehilangan sesuatu yang jauh lebih berharga daripada lelaki yang dia cintai.

programme.title: Saat Aku Tahu

programme.title: The Hidden Hand (Dia Perempuan Sialan) EP9
programme.desc: Dibelenggu oleh manipulasi kuasa ghaib serta didorong oleh dendam demi ibunya yang pernah didera, Riska bergelut untuk membatalkan perjanjian yang mengikat dirinya.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP9
programme.desc: Rancangan ini diterajui oleh pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful Azmi Jamsari serta dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan. Pengantara berada di Kg. Tanjung, Sabtu, Kuala Trengganu yang dikatakan mempunyai misteri tersendiri. Beliau bertemu dengan Encik Salleh Abdullah, beberapa istana lama yang dibina oleh Almarhum Tengku Ismail kerabat di raja Trengganu yang dijadikan pusat tenun kain songket orang kampung. Kononnya satu keluarga bunian masih berada di lokasi. Ossasuke Hikaru (OH) seorang aktivitis Paranormal berkongsi pengalaman yang pernah dilalui semasa menjalankan aktiviti di situ. Pengantara bersama OH dan krew kemudiannya berada di lokasi istana lama tersebut selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi seram dan menakutkan.

programme.title: Paku
programme.desc: Filem ini mengisahkan tentang Fahmi (Johan As'ari) yang amat mencintai isterinya Riana (Aishah Ilias) dan dia tidak dapat menerima kenyataan bahawa isterinya sudah meninggal dunia. Oleh kerna disebabkan ketaksuban cintanya itu membuatkan Fahmi sanggup mencari seorang bomoh untuk menghidupkan semula Riana. Riana telah berjaya dihidupkan semula dan mereka bersatu sehinggalah Riana melahirkan seorang anak. Namun benarkah itu adalah Riana? Apakah yang akan terjadi kepada kehidupan Fahmi selepas itu?

programme.title: Brick Mansion
programme.desc: Di Detroit dystopian, rumah besar yang pernah menempatkan orang kaya kini menjadi rumah penjenayah paling berbahaya di bandar itu. Di sekeliling kawasan itu terdapat tembok gergasi untuk memastikan seluruh Detroit selamat. Bagi polis yang menyamar Damien Collier, setiap hari adalah perjuangan menentang rasuah ketika dia berjuang untuk membawa pembunuh bapanya, Tremaine, ke muka pengadilan. Sementara itu, Damien dan bekas penipu bernama Lino bekerjasama untuk menyelamatkan bandar itu daripada komplot untuk memusnahkannya.

programme.desc: Episod kali ini menceritakan mengenai kisah Nabi Isa a.s . Penceritaan akan bermula dari pendahuluan sehinggalah kisah-kisah yang berkaitan dengan peristiwa yang membawa kepada contoh dan teladan bagi umat Islam.

programme.title: Tanya Hassan
programme.desc: Episod seterusnya, ustaz menerima soalan berkaitan dengan hukum pemindahan organ yang berlaku di hospital, adakah dibenarkan dalam islam? Ustaz menjawab, ia dibolehkan dalam islam, tetapi mempunyai beberapa syarat.

programme.title: Diari Ustaz
programme.desc: Diari Ustaz merupakan suatu rancangan yang akan mengenengahkan Ustaz tersohor negara didalam menyampaikan tazkirah dan panduan disertai hujah-hujah hadis dan Al Quran. Pengisian menjurus kepada permasalahan semasa masyarakat. Minggu ini Ustaz mengupas tentang topik 'Penipu'.

programme.title: Sembang Alam Ghaib
programme.desc: Episod kali ini membawakn topik "Lawatan ibu dan anak di Hospital". Program ini mengupas pelbagai kisah seram berkaitan alam ghaib, dengan menampilkan cerita yang diadaptasi daripada pengalaman benar yang pernah dilalui sendiri oleh Dato' Ustaz Kazim Elias. Setiap episod turut menyelitkan pengajaran dan panduan dari perspektif Islam mengenai perkara-perkara ghaib.

programme.title: Chot
programme.desc: Sehingga sekarang telinga Alias masih sakit dan bernanah disebabkan terjatuh kerana tamparan cikgu Sunan. Dia enggan beritahu ibunya kerana dia tidak mahu ibunya bertanya kepada Cikgu Sunan. Alias sekali lagi ponteng sekolah dan pergi kutip kelapa untuk cari duit kerana bekalan makanan mereka telah habis.

programme.title: Sunnah Nabi
programme.desc: Episod kali ini bersama Ustaz Tajid membawa topik "Diplomasi Rasulullah" dengan panel Ustaz Hassan Adli. Sunnah Nabi merupakan program keagamaan yang membawakan perbincangan santai namun ilmiah mengenai amalan sunnah dalam kehidupan seharian umat Islam. Program ini menampilkan pelbagai topik umum dan khusus berkaitan sunnah.

programme.title: Jogho
programme.desc: Dendam menguasai masyarakat Melayu Patani di Thailand Selatan. Kalah dalam pertempuran lembu jantan, lawannya dibunuh yang juga saudara kepada Mamat - yang berjanji untuk membalas dendam bagi kematian saudaranya. Sifat dendam dalam masyarakat Melayu tetap mengalir kerana isteri Mamat, Minah gagal untuk menghentikan kitaran kejam itu.

programme.title: Suratan Kasih
programme.desc: Sunny mengalami tekanan jiwa selepas melihat ibunya yang sedang berzina mati dibunuh ayahnya sendiri. Apabila meningkat dewasa, Sunny menjadi seorang pembunuh bersiri di sebalik kerjayanya sebagai komposer dan pemuzik. Mangsanya ialah golongan artis yang melakukan perbuatan zina. Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

programme.title: Rahsia
programme.desc: Dihantui gangguan misteri, sepasang suami isteri mula mencari punca kepada gangguan tersebut. Profesor Hamdan dan Ramlah serta anak mereka, Saiful dan Marina berpindah ke sebuah banglo lama di tepi laut. Mereka hidup aman dan damai bersama di banglo tersebut. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

programme.title: Mama Oh Mama
programme.desc: Ani, seorang perempuan yang berperwatakan liar sering melakukan perkara yang tidak dipersetujui oleh ibu bapanya . Dia sering mengunjungi kelab malam dan keluar bersama teman lelakinya . Walaupun dinasihati oleh orang gajinya, Ani tetap tidak berubah sikap.

programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Gemerlapan
programme.desc: Mimi mengejutkan ramai pelajar di sebuah kolej berprestij kerana menjadi seorang penggemar muzik dangdut yang tegar. Nel, salah seorang pelajar di situ menganggap muzik dangdut kekampungan dan mereka berdua sering bertengkar kerana hal tersebut. Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.title: Jogho
programme.desc: Dendam menguasai masyarakat Melayu Patani di Thailand Selatan. Kalah dalam pertempuran lembu jantan, lawannya dibunuh yang juga saudara kepada Mamat - yang berjanji untuk membalas dendam bagi kematian saudaranya. Sifat dendam dalam masyarakat Melayu tetap mengalir kerana isteri Mamat, Minah gagal untuk menghentikan kitaran kejam itu.
